name: Hermes Agent OS Control Plane
role: YodaOS-inspired Hermes Agent OS control-plane project: Context Graph, CapabilityGraph, Evidence DAG, AuthorityGate, Control Surface, Edge Event pipeline, and worker lease governance.
promotion_policy: evidence-gated ratchet; no validated/promoted status without current proof/readback; no cross-project secret/auth/session-state merge

audit_semantics.next_audit_action: keep native agent-os status/doctor/route readback green before any broader runtime claim

backend_contract_policy.contract_scope: Agent OS local SSOT, route/review probes, taskpool projection, local harness receipts, and exact authority/readback boundaries.
backend_contract_policy.schema_rule: Preserve sparse historical profile/receipt compatibility and fail closed on malformed authority or evidence tuples.
backend_contract_policy.compatibility_rule: Keep projections additive and read-only unless an exact enabled adapter boundary, target, receipt, rollback path, and readback are present.
backend_contract_policy.side_effect_boundary: No external dispatch, scheduler or worker lifecycle write, publish, deploy, push, credential entry, payment, or destructive action by default.

required_checks: hermes agent-os status --json and exact-intent route readback
negative_checks: missing or malformed semantic envelopes fail closed
external side effects remain blocked without exact authority
local knowledge recall remains hash-bound and authority-neutral
regression_coverage_policy.rollback_rule: Revert only the scoped profile or control-plane delta when a focused check regresses; preserve the failing receipt as evidence.

lark_task_execution_policy.primary_goal: Advance Agent OS through evidence-backed local SSOT and control-plane slices while preserving exact authority and readback gates.
execution_order: run Agent OS route preflight and baseline selfcheck
land the smallest local reversible delta
run focused positive and negative checks
attach exact file, command, and readback evidence
lark_task_execution_policy.closeout_rule: Closeout requires baseline, implementation delta, focused verification, negative boundary evidence, and fresh readback; advisory or model agreement alone is not completion authority.
